questions.stem: Which two are benefits of a managed connector over hand-written ingestion code? Each correct answer is a complete solution.

options.text: It works without network access to the source
Databricks maintains the integration with the source
It writes only to CSV files
Incremental loading is handled for you

questions.explanation: Lakeflow Connect is a fully managed service that ingests only the data changed since the prior run; the data still needs a network path and is governed in Unity Catalog.

questions.stem: A source is supported by a Lakeflow Connect connector, but the team is considering a custom JDBC notebook instead. What is the usual reason to prefer the connector?

options.text: Custom notebooks can't write Delta tables
More automation, with incremental ingestion built in
JDBC is never allowed
The connector is always free of compute cost

questions.explanation: Managed connectors are the most automated option and ingest only what changed; custom code trades automation for broader source support.
